Read results within their limits

These studies use different designs, populations and follow-up periods. Cumulative network services are not study participants. The full twelve-report set has not been independently re-analysed in this review.

The school-readiness source limits its population and does not guarantee school admission. The parent-led generalisation source notes a non-significant home-adherence/progress correlation and potential reporting bias. A positive mean change alone cannot establish causation.

The separate April 2026 external-validation DOI is a study protocol; it is not the completed-results report for this portfolio.

Sources: original Whitebook, pp12–21; Evidence Dossier v2 study register; September handout, physical p8. Original report links were identified from public company publications; full journal peer-review status and ethics documentation remain to be mapped.
